body.statement: The transport identification results of \cite{DahabrehRobertsonPetitoHernanSteingrimsson2023} condition on observed baseline effect modifiers and do not by themselves identify transport across the latent effect modifier \(U\) used here.

source.locator: Identification setup and conditional transportability assumptions

attestation.note: The primary article DOI and identification setup support the observed-modifier scope statement.
